intro: The Simple Note is a brief written summons delivered to novice tauren warriors in Camp Narache by a local messenger. Written by the trainer Harutt Thunderhorn, it calls young fighters to report for duty, reminding them of the essential role warriors play alongside druids and shamans in defending tribal borders from centaur.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, friend. I believe she was sent by the adventurer trainer Harutt. If this note is from Harutt, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, at last, you've arrived, adventurer. I did not lie in my note, friend. We are a special breed also, not unlike the druids or shamans of our tribe. You are just as important. We are the ones called upon to defend our borders, to hunt the centaur, and to go to war.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Each of us plays a role in our tribe. Each of us must also go through all the same rites. Do not ever let your pride tell you otherwise.

I remain here to train new adventurers that seek the glory of battle and who follow the ways of our oldest ancestors. When you feel ready, come back to me and I will do what I can to train you further. Go with the tribe's blessing, friend.
